decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan while steadily advancing your own board presence. With a mix of powerful card draw spells, countermagic, and efficient removal, you aim to control the game tempo and outvalue your opponent. Utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Narset and Tamiyo, along with evasive threats like Yuriko and Plagon, you can apply pressure while also generating card advantage. The mana base is carefully crafted to support your spells while also disrupting your opponent's lands with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine.

The deck focuses on leveraging efficient creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and put pressure on the opponent. By combining powerful threats like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Leovold, Emissary of Trest with disruptive elements like Force of Will and Abrupt Decay, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing a strong board presence. Additionally, the deck utilizes mana acceleration from cards like Black Lotus and Moxen to power out threats ahead of schedule. The combination of aggression and disruption allows the deck to quickly overwhelm opponents and maintain control of the game.

This deck aims to efficiently draw and set up the combo pieces needed to win the game with Doomsday. It utilizes fast mana acceleration like Mox Jet and Dark Ritual, along with cantrips like Preordain and Ponder to dig through the deck quickly. The key cards include Doomsday, Thassa's Oracle, and Demonic Consultation/Necropotence to assemble the necessary win condition. It also includes disruption like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. The deck's strategy is to set up a win with Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle as quickly as possible while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent while maintaining a strong aggressive stance. It aims to control the opponent's resources with cards like Wasteland, Chalice of the Void, and Chancellor of the Annex, while deploying efficient threats like Archon of Emeria and Stillmoon Cavalier. The deck also utilizes hatebears like Anointed Peacekeeper and White Plume Adventurer to further slow down the opponent. With a mix of disruptive elements and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory in the Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on assembling the pieces needed to generate a high amount of mana quickly and efficiently, utilizing cards like Mishra's Workshop and Paradoxical Outcome to fuel powerful spells and bring out Coveted Jewel. The deck aims to create a loop of generating mana with artifacts like Grim Monolith and Voltaic Key, as well as controlling the board with cards like Force of Will. By combining these elements, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents and seize control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Golgari Thug and Stinkweed Imp to bring back powerful creatures like Ichorid and Narcomoeba. The goal is to chain together multiple cards in the graveyard to generate a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam provide additional reach and pressure. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect the combo and prevent the opponent from disrupting the game plan.

The main focus of the deck is to use efficient artifacts and disruptive cards to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By combining mana denial with powerful threats such as Stonecoil Serpent and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. The inclusion of powerful artifacts like Mishra's Workshop and Moxen allow for explosive starts, while cards like Sphere of Resistance and Null Rod help to disrupt the opponent's strategies. Overall, the deck aims to quickly close out the game through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck aims to generate a large amount of mana through artifacts like Moxen and Black Lotus, with the ability to draw cards using Paradoxical Outcome to set up a game-winning combo. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den allows for additional value by recurring low-cost artifacts from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to interact with the opponent's game plan. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently generating resources and assembling a powerful combo to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Abrupt Decay and Collector Ouphe, while also utilizing powerful midrange threats like Leovold, Emissary of Trest and Oko, Thief of Crowns to control the board and pressure opponents. The deck has a strong mana denial plan with Wasteland and Strip Mine, along with powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to keep the cards flowing. Force of Will and Force of Negation provide additional protection, making it difficult for opponents to disrupt the deck's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with Dredge cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, enabling powerful combos with cards like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. The key strategy revolves around utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to set up explosive plays, while also disrupting opponents with cards like Grief and Force of Will. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless stream of threats from the graveyard, using its powerful Dredge engine to generate continuous advantage and pressure.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to control the game through disrupting opponent's plays with counterspells and removal while drawing cards and searching for key pieces to maintain control. The deck also utilizes cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion to provide additional value and recursion. With a mix of powerful spells and mana acceleration through artifacts, this deck aims to outplay opponents through careful sequencing and resource management in order to come out on top in the end.

This deck utilizes the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures like Narcomoeba and Stinkweed Imp. By leveraging cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Noxious Revival, the player can constantly dredge and bring back powerful threats like Prized Amalgam and Hollow One. With the ability to disrupt opponents with Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as protect the combo with cards like Ichorid and Grief, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless stream of creatures from the graveyard.

The strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing various control elements such as counterspells, removal, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining board control. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional recursion and card advantage, providing resilience in longer games. The deck also features a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells to apply pressure and control the game's pace, ultimately aiming to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a resource management battle.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through various spells and abilities. It aims to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal, and card draw to maintain board presence and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for recursion of key permanents and provides additional value in the late game. By manipulating the opponent's resources and limiting their options, this deck seeks to assert dominance and secure victory through careful tactical play.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements, such as counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures, to dominate the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to control the board and opponent's resources while efficiently drawing cards and mana ramping with powerful artifacts. Lurrus of the Dream-Den serves as a companion, providing additional value and resilience to the strategy. The deck includes a mix of early game disruption and late game powerhouses, allowing for flexibility in different matchups and adapting to various game plans.

This Esper Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful disruption spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the game and protect its key threats. By playing efficient removal and counterspells, along with card draw and selection like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies and grind out incremental advantages. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing the deck to recur low-cost permanents, while cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Wasteland help to further disrupt opposing decks.
